title: Normalization specification of a source table
description: Deterministic instructions to turn each row of the data file (CSV) into a JSON instance of the logical model, before the StructureMap. Generated by the workbench, executed by the conversion module. Given the same specification and row, the output must be byte-for-byte identical on every implementation.

formatVersion.description: Version of this specification format (semver). A reader of 1.x accepts every older 1.y; the major changes only with incompatible changes.

source.description: Name of the table in the project (e.g. FirstOverview).

logicalModel.description: URL of the logical model; also used as the resourceType of the produced instance.

input.description: How to read the data file. The conversion module may override these values at run time.

onInvalidValue.description: Value that cannot be converted (e.g. 'abc' in an integer column). fail (1.1.0): the conversion stops at the first such value and reports it, producing no rows; report-drop: the value is omitted and reported; reject-row: the whole row is discarded and reported.

ids.description: Id fields to compute, one per role created or referenced by this table.

keyId.description: If present, HMAC-SHA256 is used with the key so identified, kept outside the package. Absent = plain SHA-256.

ElementName.description: Element name in the logical model and in the FML, derived from the column name: characters outside [A-Za-z0-9_] → '_', prefix 'c' if it does not start with a letter, trailing '_' if it equals share, default, log or then (rejected by the FML grammar), numeric suffix on collision.

sourceName.description: Column header in the data file (original name).

dateFormat.description: Only for date and dateTime. Allowed symbols: yyyy, MM, dd, HH, mm, ss; every other character must match literally. Absent = already ISO 8601 in the file.

missingValues.description: Values (after trimming) treated as missing, besides the empty cell.

multiValue.description: Multiple value in one cell: split on the separator, each part trimmed, empty parts dropped, order kept, duplicates removed.

Column.description: Algorithm for each cell: 1) Unicode NFC and trim; 2) empty cell or value in missingValues → element omitted; 3) multiValue → split into a list; 4) conversion by type: string/code unchanged; integer ^[+-]?[0-9]+$ with no leading zeros in output; decimal with decimalSeparator → '.', ^[+-]?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$, digits kept; boolean from trueValues/falseValues (case-insensitive); date/dateTime according to dateFormat, calendar validity check, ISO output (YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ss without time zone). Value that cannot be converted → onInvalidValue.

columns.description: Names (name) of the columns of THIS table whose values go into the id, in order. The ALREADY NORMALIZED canonical values are used (ISO dates, numbers without superfluous zeros, NFC text without outer spaces), so different tables produce the same id for the same resource. If a column is missing in the row, the id is not computed.

IdField.description: hash: id = literals + [lowercase hex of the first hashLength characters of SHA-256 (or HMAC-SHA256) over the UTF-8 of the canonical values joined by U+001F], joined by separator. sanitize: as above, but instead of the hash the canonical values joined by separator, with every character outside [A-Za-z0-9.-] replaced by '-'. The final id must match ^[A-Za-z0-9.-]{1,64}$, otherwise the row is reported as an error.
